main_text.p: rectè juris divini esse conten-dunt. Unde insignis ille servus Dei Daniel Chamierius lib. 15. de Oecumenico Pontif. c. 1. ait, Pontificem Romanum sibi arrogare potestatem tem-poralem in statum Politi-cum, tanquam APPEN-DICEM potestatis Spiri-tualis. Ex quo per se sequitur eos, qui potestatibus superemi-nentibus eripiunt potestatem cir-ca res Ecclesiasticas, spolium committere gravissimum, rebel-lionis, adeoque laesae majestatis sese reos constituere, quemad-modum Theologi Reformati multis

page.notes: The first word "rectè" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The running head is printed as "PRÆFATIO·" with a trailing dot, which I have omitted. The catchword is "multis", printed in italic at the right, below the last line. No page number or signature is printed. The Google digitisation stamp at the lower right was left out. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed.
